description: This Java class 'CompareField' is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.minilang.operation' package. It extends 'BaseCompare' and is responsible for comparing a specific field in the input map to another field specified in an XML element. It is used within the Minilang operation framework of the Apache OFBiz project.

classes.name: CompareField
classes.description: A class that performs comparison between a field value and another specified field during Minilang operations.

methods.name: CompareField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CompareField object with an XML Element and a SimpleMapProcess instance.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the comparison logic, comparing the value of a specific field to another field, and appends messages based on the comparison.

calls: doCompare(Object, Object, List<Object>, Locale, ClassLoader, boolean)
